texts.preamble: Pradeep And 5 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 31 October, 2025 High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc:192823 High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad Criminal Revision No. - 317 of 2025 Pradeep And 5 Others .....Revisionist(s) Versus State of U.P. and Another .....Opposite Party(s) Counsel for Revisionist(s) : B.D. Shukla Counsel for Opposite Party(s) : G.A. Court No. - 91 Pradeep And 5 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 31 October, 2025
texts.facts: The allegations against the accused revisionists are that they had manufactured desi ghee. At the time of incident sixteen peti of adulterated desi ghee with the mark of Vishwas Premium of 2 kg and kg in tins and polythene packs, were recovered?nine tins from the steam vehicle and seven tins from the Maruti car. Besides this, various articles and equipment used for making adulterated ghee, including 1. two air gun, 2. two Cars, 3. two sealing machines, 4. one stove, 5. one Indian cylinder, 6. large karaha, 7. large bhagona, 8. large iron tub, 9. one machine with motor,10. one big gas furnace,11. seven empty tins,12. nine plastic containers,13. one jug, 14.tins of cream and Vishwas Premium wrappers and polythene packets, were recovered from the spot and taken into police custody. When asked about the goods loaded in the steam and Maruti vehicles, factory owner Rajesh Sharma stated that the same were being taken to be supplied to nearby people. 4. After investigation, the charge sheet has been filed against the accused persons.
texts.arguments: 5. Learned counsel for the revisionists has submitted that the impugned order passed by the Additional Sessions Judge/Special Judge (E.C. Act), Meerut dated 18.10.2024 is illegal and bad in the eye of law. It has been passed without entering into the merits of the case. Learned trial court has not discussed the evidence produced by the revisionists and did not apply his judicial mind. 6. Learned counsel for the revisionists has submitted that neither revisionists were manufacturing nor selling desi ghee when they had been arrested, as alleged by the police. The investigating officer recovered item sealed and it was sent on 22.7.2007 for examination, investigating officer stated that the said item was sent to Forensic Laboratory, Agra on 12.8.2007. The same was again sent to Forensic Laboratory, Lucknow, but without any result, it was returned to police station Kankerkhera, District Meerut on 23.10.2007. It is further submitted that the report of recovered amount should be prepared within 45 days, but the same was never tested within stipulated time. Therefore, the impugned is absolutely illegal and the same is liable to be [LEAKAGE_MASK]. 7. Learned counsel for opposite party no. 2 opposed the revision and contended that the investigation has been completed. The evidences had been collected against the revisionists, hence the objection raised by the learned counsel for the revisionists could be seen at the stage of the trial. The impugned order is liable to be confirmed and the revision is liable to be dismissed.
